plan: A small, annoying marksman who poisons, blinds and hides invisible mushrooms all over the map.
aSurveiller: His mushrooms (R). Invisible, they explode when you step on them: use the Oracle Lens or a control ward to see them.
contrer: His dart (Q) blinds you: your basic attacks miss, use your spells instead during that time.
Engage him decisively: he is very fragile and has no real escape.
Avoid tall grass without vision: that's where he hides and plants his mushrooms.
forces: Pokes a lot thanks to the poison on his attacks (E).
His mushrooms control the map and slow.
faiblesses: No escape apart from his speed (W).

sorts.P: Turns invisible if he stands still for a moment.
sorts.Q: Dart that blinds: the target misses its basic attacks.
sorts.R: Places invisible mushrooms that slow and poison.

momentFort: Annoying from the start in his lane, then especially from level 6 with his mushrooms.
